title: Quantities and rates of Song, Yuan and Ming paper money quoted in the official histories, with the 1294 Ilkhanate episode
source: 李攸《宋朝事实》卷十五；脱脱等《宋史》卷一百八十一《食货志下三》与黄畴若传；宋濂等《元史》卷八、卷二十三、卷二十四（本纪），卷九十三《食货志一》，卷九十七《食货志五》，卷一百二十五（布鲁海牙传）；张廷玉等《明史》卷八十一《食货志五》；《钦定续文献通考》卷九；P. Jackson, “ČĀV”, Encyclopaedia Iranica V/1 (1990)
series: one row per quoted fact: id, dynasty, year, year_note, value, unit, numeral, file, juan, quote, note
license: The classical texts are in the public domain; the digital text is the daizhigev20 corpus, whose repository states no licence. Only short quotations are stored. The Encyclopaedia Iranica entry is cited, not copied.
notes: Rows with file songshi, songchaoshishi, yuanshi, mingshi or xuwenxiantongkao quote the daizhigev20 corpus (commit 4a6d6f2088825f132521d848c2ea86cf9c9a7620) and are verified verbatim by data/fetch/verify_quotes.py, which also reads every numeral. Second witness: the 宋史卷181 passages quoted in the chapter were compared with the Wikisource text on 2026-10-13 (first the quota, the reserve, the Sichuan totals and the 1268 value; then all of them, by the chapter's independent reviewer) and agrees, except 绍定五年 (1232), where the two disagree (三亿 in the corpus and in the 钦定续文献通考, 二亿 on Wikisource), so both readings are kept. The Yuan figures are consistent with Guan, Palma & Wu (2024); the Ming figures have one witness. Years: the year of the event or of the memorial reporting it; year_note gives the reign date or the uncertainty (e.g. 成化年间 is plotted at 1475). Values are as stated in the text; a quotation with 余 is a lower bound. jackson1990 rows summarize the Encyclopaedia Iranica entry ČĀV (Peter Jackson, 1990). The 宋朝事实 gives the first year's issue of the official jiaozi as 3,884,600 guan (row song_first_year_issue), about three times the 宋史 quota of 1,256,340 per issue; the chapter uses the 宋史 quota and says so. The year of huizi_perpetual (淳祐七年, 1247) is inferred from the order of the passage, whose preceding reign name is miswritten (淳熙 for 淳祐).
citation: 各史卷次见 juan 列；数字文本据殆知阁古代文献
